aboutH2: Unique Therapies at Prairie Sky Recovery
intro: At Prairie Sky Recovery, they use a variety of unique and innovative therapies to help their clients overcome addiction. In addition to the traditional 12-Step program, they offer a range of evidence-based treatments like dialectical behavior therapy, motivational interviewing, and cognitive behavior therapy. They also offer mindfulness, communication, and assertiveness training, along with financial literacy programs. These therapies are designed to help clients address the root causes of their addiction and develop the skills they need to live a healthy and fulfilling life in recovery.

Another unique aspect of Prairie Sky Recovery is their use of equine therapy. Horses can be incredibly therapeutic, helping individuals to build trust, improve their communication skills, and develop a sense of responsibility. At Prairie Sky Recovery, clients can participate in horse therapy sessions, guided by experienced professionals who understand the power of this unique treatment.

pillars.title: The Serenity of Prairie Sky Recovery
pillars.body: One of the most significant benefits of seeking treatment at Prairie Sky Recovery is the serene location of the center. Situated on six acres of beautifully landscaped grounds, surrounded by the stunning natural beauty of rural Saskatchewan, Prairie Sky Recovery provides a tranquil and peaceful environment for clients to heal. The historic 20,000 square foot facility has been lovingly restored and renovated to provide all the modern comforts clients need while maintaining its original charm and character. Clients can stay in private or semi-private rooms, each offering a peaceful and relaxing retreat from the outside world.

pillars.title: The Benefits of Whole Person Recovery at Prairie Sky
pillars.body: Prairie Sky Recovery takes a whole-person approach to addiction treatment, addressing every aspect of a client’s physical, mental, emotional, and spiritual health. This holistic approach recognizes that addiction is a complex disease that requires a multi-faceted treatment approach. By treating the whole person, Prairie Sky Recovery helps clients to heal from the inside out. They work with each individual to develop a personalized treatment plan that addresses their unique needs and helps them build the skills they need to create a successful and lasting recovery.

pillars.title: Addiction Treatment for Men of Every Background
pillars.body: Prairie Sky Recovery is committed to helping men and male-identifying people who need addiction treatment, regardless of their background, religion, or sexual orientation. Their evidence-based approach to addiction treatment is effective for people of all colors, creeds, and orientations. They are nonjudgmental and provide a safe and supportive environment for clients to heal. Whether you are struggling with substance abuse, alcohol addiction, or non-substance addiction, Prairie Sky Recovery can help.

overview: Prairie Sky Recovery Centre is a leading facility for providing evidence-based addiction recovery programs. The centre is based on a relational approach that addresses the entire person, including physical, mental, emotional and spiritual aspects. The rehabilitation programs offered by the centre are personalized and catered to each individual client, making them client-centered and effective.

One of the unique features of their programs is the inclusion of all 12 steps, cognitive behavior therapy, and dialectical behavioral therapy, among others. Their staff is experienced, empathetic, and caring, with many individuals having lived experience with addiction. Their philosophy of providing addiction recovery support is applied throughout the centre, which is why they were recipients of the 2018 BBB Torch Award and a finalist for the Chamber ABEX award in 2018 and 2019. Prairie Sky Recovery Centre is committed to enhancing successful addiction recovery through their supportive, caring approach that builds recovery capital and leaves clients with a healthy and sustainable pathway forward.

faqIntro: Answers come from the centre's listing and its own website. Still unsure? Call, it's free and confidential.

faqs.q: How much does Prairie Sky Recovery cost?
faqs.a: Prairie Sky does not publish its prices, so you need to call 1-888-519-4445 for the cost of each program. The centre says its fees are, on average, lower than other private Canadian treatment centres because it runs as a simple recovery retreat without luxury extras. A deposit by Visa, Mastercard or e-transfer holds your bed.

faqs.q: How long is the program at Prairie Sky Recovery?
faqs.a: Our programs range from 42 to 90 days, depending on the needs of each individual client.

faqs.q: Is Prairie Sky Recovery for men only?
faqs.a: Yes. The centre describes itself as Saskatchewan's men's only private recovery centre, with 28 beds for men and male-identifying people. Women looking for residential care in Saskatchewan can compare other centres on our Saskatchewan page.

faqs.q: Does Prairie Sky Recovery offer detox?
faqs.a: Not medical detox. Prairie Sky runs a Pre-Program Readiness Social Detox for people who arrive early, which helps with any resistance to starting treatment. If you need medically supervised withdrawal first, the centre's FAQ lists detox services in Saskatoon, Regina, Prince Albert, Moose Jaw, Meadow Lake, La Ronge and Lloydminster.

faqs.q: Where is Prairie Sky Recovery and how do I get there?
faqs.a: The centre is in the hamlet of Leipzig, about 15 minutes south of Wilkie in west central Saskatchewan. It is about an hour and a half west of Saskatoon and 45 minutes south of North Battleford. If you fly into Saskatoon International Airport, staff can pick you up for an extra charge, and they will send detailed driving directions on request.

faqs.q: Can my family participate in my treatment at Prairie Sky Recovery?
faqs.a: Yes, we offer a 2-day psychoeducation program for families of clients to participate in.

faqs.q: Will I be required to participate in the 12-Step program at Prairie Sky Recovery?
faqs.a: Yes, the 12-Step program is part of our overall treatment approach at Prairie Sky Recovery, but we offer a range of other evidence-based therapies as well.

faqs.q: What types of addiction does Prairie Sky Recovery treat?
faqs.a: We treat all kinds of addiction, including substance abuse, alcohol addiction, and non-substance addictions such as gambling and food addiction.

faqs.q: Is Prairie Sky private? Can insurance or my employer pay?
faqs.a: Yes, Prairie Sky is a private, fee-based centre. It says it is often covered by insurers such as Canada Life, Manulife and Sun Life, and that EAPs, employers, unions and Child & Family Services sometimes help with fees. Staff can provide confirmation letters and help with funding applications.

You leave with a Recovery Maintenance Action Plan written before you finish. Past clients can stay in touch with staff, use the virtual portal and outreach team, attend the open AA and NA meetings held at the centre, and go to alumni events and meetings in communities around Saskatchewan.

faqs.q: Can clients use phones or have visitors?
faqs.a: Clients can call friends and family from a private phone space, free within Canada, once they finish their first week of group therapy. Personal cellphones and other electronics are not allowed during the stay. To protect privacy, staff will not confirm whether someone is a client or take messages, but letters and cards can be mailed to Box 535, Wilkie, SK S0K 4W0.

faqs.q: Can I bring my pet to Prairie Sky Recovery?
faqs.a: No, we cannot allow pets at our facility due to the potential for disruption to other clients and staff.
